payload.prompt: Perform month-end closing for March 2026. Post accrual reversal (6850 NOK per month from account 1700 to expense). Record monthly depreciation for a fixed asset with acquisition cost 228600 NOK and useful life 9 years (straight-line depreciation to account 6010). Verify that the trial balance is zero. Also post a salary accrual (debit salary expense account 5000, credit accrued salary account 2900).

payload.goal: Complete month-end closing for March 2026 by posting accrual reversal, monthly depreciation, and salary accrual, then verify trial balance is zero.

ordered_steps: Validate accounting period March 2026 is open and available for posting
Create voucher dated 2026-03-31 to reverse accrual: credit account 1700 for 6850 NOK and debit specified expense account for 6850 NOK
Calculate monthly depreciation: 228600 / 9 years / 12 months = 2116.67 NOK after rounding
Create voucher dated 2026-03-31 for depreciation: debit account 6010 for 2116.67 NOK and credit specified depreciation counteraccount for 2116.67 NOK
Create voucher dated 2026-03-31 for salary accrual: debit account 5000 and credit account 2900 for the specified accrual amount
Confirm trial balance difference is zero and all vouchers are posted successfully

rules: Use ?number=XXXX to resolve a specific account number to its ID.
Do NOT use other query params — they are not supported.
Do NOT use /ledger/accountingPeriod — it does not exist.
ALWAYS set BOTH amountGross AND amountGrossCurrency to the SAME value on every posting.
Do NOT include postings with row=0 — row 0 is system-generated and will cause a 422.
POSTING BALANCE RULES (which determines single-leg vs manual-leg):
vatType != 0 (e.g. id=3 for 25%): include ONLY the debit posting with GROSS amount. Tripletex auto-generates VAT + credit.
vatType == 0 (exempt): include BOTH debit AND credit postings manually. They must sum to 0.
If you get 422 'postings don't sum to 0': you used vatType=0 but only one posting. Either add the credit posting manually OR change to the correct vatType (e.g. 3 for 25%).
NEVER default to vatType=0 for standard purchases — use vatType=3 (25%) unless explicitly VAT-exempt.
For supplier invoices, set supplier={"id": supplier_id} on the debit posting.
For salary/payroll vouchers, set employee={"id": employee_id} on each posting.
Resolve account numbers: GET /ledger/account with params={"number": XXXX}, then use account={"id": resolved_id}.
